approach: Check both parts of the statement against the definition of projectile motion: its plane of motion and its acceleration.

steps.text: A projectile moves in a vertical plane, so its motion needs two coordinates: it is two-dimensional.
Its only acceleration is gravity, which stays constant in magnitude and direction through the whole flight.
Both parts of the statement match the physics of projectile motion, so the statement is true.

common_mistakes.text: Believing the acceleration changes because the velocity direction keeps changing during the flight, when only the velocity changes, not the acceleration.
